cases.detail: stage 1 prepares this script and does not execute GPU load or inference Pass condition: Container is up, /health and /control/status succeed, state is unloaded/not_resident/active 0, and no model load was started.
stage 1 prepares this script and does not execute GPU load or inference Pass condition: Owned vLLM worker becomes ready, /v1/models lists the expected served model, and status is ready/resident.
stage 1 prepares this script and does not execute GPU load or inference Pass condition: Non-streaming chat completion returns OpenAI-shaped JSON and the request body is unchanged.
stage 1 prepares this script and does not execute GPU load or inference Pass condition: Streaming chat completion yields SSE chunks and finishes without a lifecycle error.
stage 1 prepares this script and does not execute GPU load or inference Pass condition: One base64 image_url is interpreted; the run is not forced down a text-only path.
stage 1 prepares this script and does not execute GPU load or inference Pass condition: Multiple base64 images in one chat request are accepted and answered.

stage 1 prepares this script and does not execute GPU load or inference Pass condition: Logs or metrics record Marlin, KV dtype/scale, decoder attention, vision attention, and GDN state dtype. Recording is not a pass by itself.
stage 1 prepares this script and does not execute GPU load or inference Pass condition: Text-only, image+text, and mixed requests each run at concurrency 1 with no error or OOM.
stage 1 prepares this script and does not execute GPU load or inference Pass condition: The same three input kinds overlap at concurrency 2 and engine logs show batching.

stage 1 prepares this script and does not execute GPU load or inference Pass condition: The same three input kinds overlap at concurrency 4, within the external limit, with batching observed and no OOM.
stage 1 prepares this script and does not execute GPU load or inference Pass condition: Prompt plus image tokens plus the output budget approach 32K without treating preemption as success.
stage 1 prepares this script and does not execute GPU load or inference Pass condition: Declared image count, max_pixels, context, output budget, and concurrency are exercised together.
stage 1 prepares this script and does not execute GPU load or inference Pass condition: Unload during an in-flight request returns 409 BUSY, and active_requests is 0 only after upstream completion.
stage 1 prepares this script and does not execute GPU load or inference Pass condition: GET /control/status answers during load and unload without waiting on model initialization.
stage 1 prepares this script and does not execute GPU load or inference Pass condition: At least three load/unload cycles end with every owned worker gone and no growing residual allocation.
stage 1 prepares this script and does not execute GPU load or inference Pass condition: A bad model path or option becomes failed with a residency that matches worker ownership.
stage 1 prepares this script and does not execute GPU load or inference Pass condition: A load deadline records failed and does not report not_resident before cleanup is confirmed.
stage 1 prepares this script and does not execute GPU load or inference Pass condition: A worker crash becomes failed immediately and does not clear active until ownership says every worker is gone.

stage 1 prepares this script and does not execute GPU load or inference Pass condition: Stopping the controller reaps workers; unless-stopped starts a new process that is unloaded and does not auto-load.
